summary.text: Robert Dawson is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 65 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked in financial technology, cybersecurity, and software development and compliance.

paragraphs.text: Dawson was born in Birmingham, Alabama.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Sarah Lawrence College in 1994, a graduate degree from Harvard University in 2010 and a graduate degree from Bennington College in 2014.
His career experience includes working in financial technology, cybersecurity, and software development and compliance.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked as a staff writer in the U.S. House of Representatives and as a consultant in finance and information technology, and that he served on the City of South Fulton Zoning Board of Appeals.
Dawson succeeded Mandisha A. Thomas in District 65, assuming office on January 13, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Agriculture and Consumer Affairs Committee, the Information and Audits Committee and the Intragovernmental Coordination Committee.
